proposals.before: Grand Mentor Zhangsun Wuji and others assisted in government; the realm saw no loss of virtue.
proposals.after: Grand Commandant Zhangsun Wuji and others assisted in government; the realm saw no loss of virtue.
proposals.reason: 太尉 denotes Grand Commandant (taiwei), not Grand Mentor (taifu); the literal mistranslates the office title.

decisions.reason: Chinese 太尉 is the office taiwei (Grand Commandant); Grand Mentor would be 太傅 (taifu). The proposed replacement correctly restores the title while leaving the rest of the sentence unchanged.
